news.text: Our paper "Leveraging Motion Estimation for Efficient Bayer-Domain Computer Vision" was accepted by ICIP 2026.
Our paper "DistillSleepNet: Heterogeneous Multi-Level Knowledge Distillation via Teacher Assistant for Sleep Staging" was accepted by IEEE Transactions on Big Data.
Our paper "Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Enhanced Unimodal Emotion Recognition" was accepted by IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing.
Our paper "Mutual Distillation Extracting Spatial-Temporal Knowledge for Lightweight Multi-Channel Sleep Stage Classification" was accepted by ACM SIGKDD 2024.
Start my study in Tsinghua University.
